market_question: Will New People (NL) gain the most seats in the next Russian parliamentary election?
reasoning: New People won only 13 seats in 2021 (2.9%) and remains a minor, Kremlin‑tolerated party. The chance they gain more seats than any other party is very low, likely <10%, as larger opposition parties like the CPRF (57 seats) could easily gain more or United Russia’s net loss might be smaller. The 28% market price is inflated, likely reflecting sentiment rather than structural probabilities.
evidence_points: New People secured 13 seats in the 2021 Duma (5.3% of the vote) and is a small, systemic opposition party.
Larger parties such as the CPRF (57 seats) or LDPR (21 seats) have better potential to achieve a higher net seat gain.
The Kremlin tightly controls electoral outcomes, and a scenario where a minor party like New People records the largest gain—over all others—is improbable.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of Russian electoral dynamics and Kremlin influence
